html:
Explore the beauty of Huong Quang Phu Cau village for half a day, will bring you the most enjoyable experiences, Huong Quang Phu Cau village is located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, is one of the traditional craft villages, the village is currently the hottest check-in spot.

Coming to Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you will be able to freely check in for yourself beautiful photos next to colorful bundles of incense, arranged in many different styles, which will bring you beautiful photos. From Hanoi, you travel to Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you only need half a day to fully explore the beauty of the traditional incense village.

In the morning, the car will pick you up at the meeting point in Hanoi capital, depart for Huong Quang Phu Cau village, if you travel on your own, you can go by motorbike or bus.

If you are a person who likes to sightsee, you should travel to Huong Quang Phu Cau village by motorbike while enjoying the scenery. When you get out of the inner city, you will be able to enjoy the peaceful and rustic countryside scenery that exudes its own beauty.

If you travel Huong Quang Phu Cau village by bus, from the center of Hanoi, you follow National Highway QL21B, Provincial Road 429, then take bus 91 from Yen Nghia bus station and depart through the villages. A scene appears right before your eyes like a rustic picture of the countryside.

When you arrive at Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you should walk around the village to visit and see how to make incense bundles. You can visit the production facilities and make incense sticks with the villagers.

You can see how people make things from the simple steps such as cutting bamboo, dyeing it with medicine, mixing incense powder and drying it in the sun. In addition, you can also chat with the incense makers, you can film the scene from the time of making until the finished incense bundles, which are one of the indispensable products in every family.

Nowadays, incense is not only sold domestically, but also exported abroad, not only developing the picture of Vietnamese countryside, but also bringing high income to the villagers, coming to Huong Quang Phu Cau village, you can walk around to admire the scenery and learn about the incense making process.

So if you want to explore the beauty of traditional Vietnamese craft villages, you don’t need to spend too much time, just half a day, you will be satisfied to explore the beauty of Huong Quang Phu Cau village and record the most beautiful moments with the villagers who are engrossed in making the most sophisticated products.
